What we do

Corporate gifts and branded clothing, handled end to end

Most of our clients are marketing people with a date, a number and a budget. We take it from there: choosing, branding, packing and delivering, with one person on our side who owns the whole order.

Gifts for clients and staff

Year-end, onboarding, thank-yous, milestones, conferences. We work from the current ranges at Amrod, KMQ and Barron and only put forward things we would be happy to receive.

Browse by occasion

Branded clothing

Golfers, jackets, hoodies, caps and workwear from Barron, Amrod, Captivity and Headwear24. Embroidery or print, sizing runs, and a physical sample for sign-off when the order justifies it.

See clothing

Packaging and delivery

Boxes, tissue, swing tags and a card in your words. Delivered to your office, or to each person's home when the team is spread out.

Brief us
How an order works

Three steps, one team, no handoffs

1. Source

You tell us the occasion, the numbers, the budget per person and the date. Within [REPLY TIME] we send a short list with indicative costs, not a catalogue.

2. Package

You pick. We prepare artwork, send a proof, and only go to print or embroidery once you have signed it off. Packaging is decided at the same time.

3. Send

We deliver to your office or straight to your people. Typical lead time from sign-off is [LEAD TIME]. We deliver to [DELIVERY AREAS].

What buyers ask us

The practical questions, answered

Is there a minimum order?

[MIN ORDER] on most items. Some clothing lines have their own minimums per colour and size, and we will tell you before you commit.

How long does it take?

[LEAD TIME] for branded orders from proof sign-off. Unbranded items are faster. Year-end orders should be briefed by [YEAR-END CUT-OFF].

What do you need from us?

Your logo as a vector file (AI, EPS, PDF or SVG), a contact for sign-off, and a delivery address. If you do not have a vector logo, we can usually redraw it.

Where do you deliver?

[DELIVERY AREAS]. Courier to the rest of South Africa is quoted per order.

Are you B-BBEE compliant?

[BEE LEVEL]. A certificate is available on request.

Can we see samples first?

Yes. For clothing and larger gift orders we bring physical samples to you before you sign off.

Occasion, numbers, budget and a date. That is enough to start.
